description: REQ-001's regression edge case ('Non-franklin instance: existing EVM (viem) address resolution behavior is unchanged byte-for-byte') is asserted in prose but has no dedicated automated test directly invoking runtime/wallet-address.mjs's CLI output before vs. after this sprint's daemon.sh restructuring. runtime/anicca-daemon.sh:120-130 replaced a guarded single-branch skip ('if INSTANCE != franklin') with an explicit if/else that now runs `cd "$REPO/runtime/compute-proxy" && node "$REPO/runtime/wallet-address.mjs"` inside the else arm -- textually identical to the prior invocation, and runtime/wallet-address.mjs itself is untouched, so the practical regression risk is very low. Coverage relies on (a) this code being byte-identical to what shipped before, and (b) the underlying resolve-identity.test.mjs suite (which tests loadEvmKey/resolveEvmPrivateKey directly, not the CLI wrapper) staying green -- neither is a direct end-to-end assertion that `node runtime/wallet-address.mjs` still prints the same address for a non-franklin instance after this restructuring.

evidence.snippet: if [ "$INSTANCE" = "franklin" ]; then ... export ANICCA_WALLET_ADDRESS="${ANICCA_WALLET_ADDRESS:-$(node "$REPO/runtime/wallet-address-solana.mjs" 2>/dev/null)}" else export ANICCA_WALLET_ADDRESS="${ANICCA_WALLET_ADDRESS:-$(cd "$REPO/runtime/compute-proxy" && node "$REPO/runtime/wallet-address.mjs" 2>/dev/null)}" fi

recommendedAction: Non-blocking. Consider adding one daemon-script-franklin-routing.test.mjs-style test that extracts and runs the non-franklin wallet-export line snippet (mirroring the PORT-snippet execution pattern already used in that file) against a fixture $HOME/.automaton/wallet.json to close this gap explicitly.
